pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions on the mid-flank with smooth-to-sub-angular edge gradients. Spatial area of patches decreases significantly towards the posterior and lower limbs, transitioning into smaller, more fragmented clusters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected light-toned pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quad-radial intersections. Pixel thickness is non-uniform, being widest on the neck-shoulder transition and narrowing towards the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette is visible along the mane at the upper neck and shoulder transition.
